Name: Gentle Energy
Author: IDemonicViperI
Description:
[b]Gentle Energy[/b] is a lightweight Stardew Valley mod designed to make your farming days more enjoyable by reducing energy consumption during everyday activities.
By default, energy usage is reduced by [b]50%[/b], allowing you to spend more time farming, mining, fishing, and exploring without constantly worrying about exhaustion.
[b]Features:[/b]
[list]
[*]50% reduced energy consumption by default.[/*]
[*]Fully configurable energy reduction (0–100%).[/*]
[*]Supports common energy-consuming activities.[/*]
[*]Multiplayer-friendly.[/*]
[*]Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6+ and SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]Enjoy longer, more productive days in the valley without completely removing the challenge of managing your energy!
